services.desc: 1 Person $150 for 1 Horseback Lesson $280 for 2 Horseback Lesson $450 for 4 Horseback Lessons 2 People (Semi-private) $200 for 1 Horseback Lesson Instructions After purchasing, please call us to book your time slots. Please have your code ready for redemption when calling to book! About Dating back to 1978, Princeville Ranch has offered Kauai horseback riding on our beautiful working cattle ranch. We now once again offer riding lessons for children and adults! We follow a holistic approach to both teaching and riding, giving equal attention to rider enjoyment, horse health and training. Starting from $150 for 1 lesson
